about_the_game:
The light novel sequel to Memory's Dogma Code:01. Contains PDF/ePub versions in English and PDF version in Japanese.

NOTE: Contains spoilers from Memory's Dogma Code:01 so it is recommended to have finished Memory's Dogma Code:01 in either visual novel or light novel form beforehand.

STORY - Akane Route

After Akane and Ema barely escaping Sigma's attack at Tokyo University's graduate research institute's memorial hall, they slip away onto their hideout truck with Hiroki Kusuhara and ponder their next move. With the advice of Akizuki—an old friend of Akane's father—and the discovery of Akane's father's MRD, their quest for the truth slowly but surely progresses. Furthermore, light is shed on Akane and Ema's complicated relationship, as well as the convictions fueling Akane's offbeat appearance and behavior...

STAFF LIST

Author: Wataru Takahashi
Illustrator: Picpicgram
Scenario Assistant: Youichi Hiragino
Original Work: LizArts

Translation: Zombie M
Editing: John Hooper (Lemnisca LLC)
Typesetting: Miranda Garza
